claim_boundary: This receipt supports only the eight public fresh-context forward-behavior cases and 20 exact bound artifacts in attempt 21. It does not support held-out performance, candidate superiority, human learning outcomes, browser inspection, field accessibility, distribution integrity, or side-effect claims outside the bound corpus.
